properties.query:
SOURCE logGroups(namePrefix: ["/aws/api/api_PREFIX_VAR"], class: "STANDARD") |
fields @timestamp, resourcePath, responseLatency, status, httpMethod
| filter isPresent(httpMethod)
| stats 
    count(*) as cantidadReq,
    sum(status < 300) as status2xx,
    sum(status >= 400 and status < 500) as status4xx,
    sum(status >= 500) as status5xx,
    avg(responseLatency) as LatenciaPromedio
    by resourcePath, httpMethod
| sort resourcePath asc
| limit 10000
properties.title: APIs Overview

properties.query:
SOURCE logGroups(namePrefix: [], class: "STANDARD") |
fields @timestamp, @message, @logStream, @log,responseLatency,status
|display  
  status >= 200 AND status < 300 as code200,
  status >= 400 and status < 500 as code400, 
  status >= 500 as code500
|stats 
  sum(code200) AS code2xx, 
  sum(code500) as code5xx, 
  sum(code400) as code4xx, 
  COUNT(*) AS totalRQ  by datefloor (@timestamp , 1m) as fecha
| sort fecha desc
| limit 10000
properties.title: STATUS CODE API

properties.query:
SOURCE '/aws/api/api_mcm_accounts' | SOURCE '/aws/api/api_client_management' | SOURCE '/aws/api/api_credit_card_management' | SOURCE '/aws/api/api_mcm_loans' | SOURCE '/aws/api/api_mcm_payments' | SOURCE '/aws/api/api_products_management' | fields @timestamp, @message, @logStream, @log, responseLatency,status
|display  responseLatency,95 
|filter resourcePath = "{{API}}"
|stats pct (responseLatency,95) AS PCT95 , avg (responseLatency) as promedio  by datefloor (@timestamp , 1m) as fecha
| sort fecha desc
| limit 10000

properties.query:
SOURCE '/aws/ecs/srv/accounts-debit-encumbrance-mngr' | SOURCE '/aws/ecs/srv/accounts-encumbrance-mngr' | SOURCE '/aws/ecs/srv/accounts-favorites-mngr' | SOURCE '/aws/ecs/srv/accounts-movements-mngr' | SOURCE '/aws/ecs/srv/accounts-pockets-mngr' | SOURCE '/aws/ecs/srv/accounts-terms-mngr' | SOURCE '/aws/ecs/srv/accounts-transfer-account-mngr' | SOURCE '/aws/ecs/srv/accounts-transfer-ach-mngr' | SOURCE '/aws/ecs/srv/accounts-transfer-wallet-mngr' | SOURCE '/aws/ecs/srv/clients-company-mngr' | SOURCE '/aws/ecs/srv/clients-mngr' | SOURCE '/aws/ecs/srv/clients-profile-mngr' | SOURCE '/aws/ecs/srv/credit-cards-advance-mngr' | SOURCE '/aws/ecs/srv/credit-cards-detail-mngr' | SOURCE '/aws/ecs/srv/credit-cards-movements-mngr' | SOURCE '/aws/ecs/srv/loans-drawdown-mngr' | SOURCE '/aws/ecs/srv/loans-rate-details-mngr' | SOURCE '/aws/ecs/srv/payments-agreements-mngr' | SOURCE '/aws/ecs/srv/payments-cvv-status-mngr' | SOURCE '/aws/ecs/srv/payments-dynamic-cvv-mngr' | SOURCE '/aws/ecs/srv/payments-favorites-mngr' | SOURCE '/aws/ecs/srv/payments-pse-pay-mngr' | SOURCE '/aws/ecs/srv/payments-scheduled-mngr' | SOURCE '/aws/ecs/srv/payments-soap-proxy-mngr' | SOURCE '/aws/ecs/srv/products-balance-mngr' | SOURCE '/aws/ecs/srv/products-balance-partners-mngr' | SOURCE '/aws/ecs/srv/products-mngr' | SOURCE '/aws/ecs/srv/products-partners-mngr' | fields @timestamp, @message, @logStream, @log
|filter @message like "AUDIT" 
|parse @message /RqUid=(?<rq_uid>[A-Za-z0-9-]+)[^A-Za-z0-9-]/
|parse @message /requestUid=(?<rq_uid1>[A-Za-z0-9-]+)[^A-Za-z0-9-]/
|parse @message /X-FnctName=(?<fnctName>[A-Za-z0-9-]+)[^A-Za-z0-9-]/
|parse @message /X-Name=(?<Name>[A-Za-z0-9-]+)[^A-Za-z0-9-]/
|parse @message "::AUDIT::*::" as TipoOperacion
|parse @message "::AUDIT::*" as mensaje
|display  @timestamp , coalesce(rq_uid , rq_uid1) as Rquid , fnctName ,  Name ,  TipoOperacion , mensaje 
|filter Rquid like "{{rquid}}"
| sort Rquid desc
| limit 100
properties.title: AUDITORIAS API

properties.query:
SOURCE logGroups(namePrefix: ["/aws/api/api_PREFIX_VAR"], class: "STANDARD") |
fields @timestamp, @message, @logStream, @log |filter @message like "::AUDIT::REQ::" or @message like "::AUDIT::RESP::"
|parse @message "::HTTPCODE::*" as CodesHTTP
|parse @message "::[X-RqUid=*,X-Name=PN-" as RqUidReq
|parse @message "X-Referer=*,X-RqUid=*,X" as ApiCliente , RquidResp
|parse @message /BODY::(?<body>\{.*\})/ 
|display jsonParse(body) as body1
    |display CodesHTTP  , body1.error.code as code  , body1.error.system as System , body1.error.message as ErrorMessage , body1.from.productType  , coalesce(RquidResp,RqUidReq) as RqUid , ApiCliente , substr(@log,13) as logroup
| filter isPresent(body1.error.message)
|stats count (*) as CantReq  by  body1.error.message , body1.error.system ,  logroup
| sort CantReq desc , logroup asc
| limit 1000
properties.title: SUMATORIA EVENTOS APIS

properties.query:
SOURCE logGroups(namePrefix: '/aws/ecs/srv/${Cluster}', class: "STANDARD") | fields @timestamp, @message, @logStream, @log
|filter @message like "RSIN"
|parse @message "RSIN *:*,3=*" as adaptador ,temp1,  rsinadpstratus
|parse @message "RSIN *:*, 1=*" as  adaptador1 , temp , rsinloaniseris
|display coalesce (rsinadpstratus,rsinloaniseris) as TiempoAdp ,substr (@log , 26 , 30)  as Adaptador 
|filter Adaptador like "{{adaptador}}" 
|stats pct(TiempoAdp , 95) as pct95 , avg (TiempoAdp)  by datefloor (@timestamp,1m) 

| limit 10000
